changelog: Rebuilt the weather transition engine for smooth multi-stage fronts and added real-time coordinate-based spatial weather blending.
Added full in-game Tri-Regional boundary editor (interactive Y-axis map bar, player position capture, buffer width, and per-region weather weights) with progressive distance blending.
Added 4 Seasons Weather & Probability Studio to customize allowed weather types and temperature offsets per season directly in-game.
Added collapsible inline Advanced Settings drawers inside every tab, synced with live save/discard tracking, plus major UI contrast and text readability improvements.

Redesigned Aurora Borealis into multi-curtain volumetric ribbons with 4 selectable palettes and intensity control, and upgraded Special Zones with edge feathering, 8 presets, drag-to-resize handles, and quick actions.
